title: Site-wide sweep for the $299 Network and three-Space Collective numbers

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const t=fs.readFileSync('lib/page-editor/templates/pricing.ts','utf8');const h=fs.readFileSync('content/help/spaces/network.md','utf8');const m=[];if(t.includes('Talk to us to set it up'))m.push('pricing template still says Talk to us');if(!/starts with three chapters/i.test(h))m.push('network help does not say three chapters');if(m.length){console.error('LIVE-1267: '+m.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"

detail: Deep scan after LIVE-1266 (ADR-1817) of code, copy, help, ADRs and live Stripe. Stripe: the four old base prices (price_1USlPE.., price_1USlPQ.., price_1USlPY.., price_1USlPt..) archived 2026-10-21 after #3798 merged; coupons and chapter prices already match the new base. Repo: the page-editor pricing template no longer says Network is set up by talking to us (it is self-serve with a trial), the Network help article says a Network starts with three chapters, the Chapters module note says they come with the plan, the library quota comment says three member Spaces, ADR-1815 points at ADR-1817. /pricing visual baselines recaptured because the template words moved.
